title: Tcs Font Pack - Cartoon
description: Tcs Font Pack - Cartoon — A Minecraft resource pack that replaces in-game fonts with playful, cartoon-style lettering. Requires Caxton mod.
body:
# Tcs Font Pack - Cartoon

A cartoon-style font replacement for Minecraft, designed to give your game a lively, hand-drawn look.

## Features
- Replaces standard Minecraft fonts with a custom cartoon typeface
- Supports Minecraft Java Edition versions 1.20.x, 1.21.x, and 26.1.x
- Lightweight and easy to toggle

## Requirements
- **Caxton mod** — this resource pack will not work without it

## Why use this pack?
If you're making a fun, whimsical build, a kid-friendly server, or just want your UI to feel less serious, this font pack adds personality to every sign, book, and chat message.

## Compatibility
- Minecraft: Java Edition
- Versions: 1.20.x, 1.21.x, 26.1.x

## Installation
1. Install [Caxton mod](link-to-caxton)
2. Drop the resource pack into your `resourcepacks` folder
3. Activate it in Options > Resource Packs
